text:
olivia: FYI seeing a 20m spike of tiny-gpu evictions in us-west1 starting ~03:30 UTC. Apps in gpu-tiny namespace returned 5xxs for a bit.

matt: yep, warm-pool autoscaler scaled down aggressively at 03:28 (policy kicked for low observed queue). us-west1-b ended up with 0 warm replicas and then provisioning lagged, scheduler started preempting to rebalance which cascaded.

ops-bot: [alert] evictions.wave(us-west1) 7965432100 - 74 evictions in 18m, peak preempt-rate 6/s, median reschedule delay 22s

sandeep: digging into events: provisioning lag lookup shows cloud quota throttles for node pool in us-west1-b at 03:26 -> API retries increased provisioning time from ~90s to ~6m. That explains the bucketed warmdown+provision gap.

jin: also noticed AZ skew: us-west1-a had spare capacity but cross-AZ placement is penalized by our anti-affinity weight for tiny-gpu fractional-gang. Scheduler tried to move pods within region rather than cross-AZ, so preempt+rebind loops increased.

olivia: logs snippet:
```
I0330 03:29:14 scheduler.go:512] evicting pod ml-worker-7 due to lower priority reclaim: attempted bind to us-west1-a failed: node selectors mismatch (az label)
I0330 03:29:15 evictor.go:120] evicted pod ml-worker-7, requeue attempt=3
I0330 03:29:16 binder.go:205] bind failed: node affinity conflict: require az=us-west1-b
```

matt: TL;DR root causes: 1) aggressive warmdown policy (scale-to-zero-ish) 2) cloud provisioning throttled (quota/API) causing warm pool hole 3) strict cross-AZ penalty makes scheduler try local reshuffles and preempt instead of crossing AZ.

sandeep: immediate mitigations I can apply:
- bump warm-pool min for gpu-tiny in us-west1 by +3 replicas
- pause warmdown autoscaler for 30m (kubectl patch)
- reduce cross-AZ penalty: scheduler flag --az-penalty=5 -> 1 (canary in us-west1-a)

jin: also recommend temporarily allow cross-AZ fractional packing for tiny-gpu to reduce preempts: workload-class patch to set allowCrossAZFractional=true for gpu-tiny.

olivia: commands (rollbackable):
```bash
kubectl -n infra patch hpa warmpool-gpu-tiny -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}' --type=merge
kubectl -n infra patch cronjob warmdown-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}' --type=merge
# scheduler config change is in the kube-system configmap, will canary
```

ops-bot: [note] scheduled action: warmdown-autoscaler suspend in us-west1 at 7965432140 by matt

matt: canary applied in us-west1-a; monitoring eviction rate. If stable, we'll apply region-wide. Also raising a cloud support ticket for quota throttling to avoid repeat.

sandeep: medium-term fixes:
- add a cooldown guard in warm-pool autoscaler: only scale down if cluster provisioning SLOs are green for 10m
- add cloud-api-retry/backoff metrics to autoscaler decisioning
- soften cross-AZ penalty for tiny workloads and add a policy that allows cross-AZ ephemeral placement when warm-pool depth < threshold
- instrument "warm-pool-fill-failure" metric to alert earlier

jin: runbook updates: I'll add a section "Warmdown + quota-induced eviction wave" with steps: pause autoscaler, raise warmpool, relax AZ penalty, open cloud-quota ticket, monitor for 1h. Also include cost delta calc template.

olivia: initial canary looks better: evictions in us-west1-a dropped to baseline, us-west1-b still catching up. Cost hit estimate ~2.8 GPU-hours wasted, ~10% delta for the 30m window. Filing follow-up ENG-PLAT ticket with root cause and draft postmortem.

matt: good. after region rollout we'll restore autoscaler with new cooldown guard. tagging on-call for 6h watch. :eyes:
